defaultOrder: Main arcs stay uninterrupted in publication sequence: Воители → Новое пророчество → Сила трёх → Знамение звёзд → Начало племён → Видение теней → Нарушенный закон → Беззвёздное племя → Меняющиеся небеса. Supplements wait until the end of the main arc containing their latest spoiler-safe anchor from the official guide. This conservative arc-boundary combined order and later-book placements are explicitly our inference, not an official unique total order.

warnings: This is a researched bibliography, not proof that the entire Russian series is available to the application. Every full-text candidate must be checked through the client.
Russian translations of arcs 7–9 and several later supplements lack confirmed publisher release metadata here; their search labels may be fan translations.
Dates and most Russian mappings are marked secondary. Do not describe every Russian label as an official canonical publisher title.
Dates of an official website post are NOT a book publication date. They were not used.
The same English Super Edition often became two Russian volumes. Preserve both in their own Russian order. Collection/omnibus and individual editions overlap.
Graphic novels contain visual storytelling. A text-only parser may not produce a complete reading edition even if a catalogue card exists.

Official catalogue ordering of SkyClan manga lists After the Flood before Beyond the Code; cross-language original publication dates support The Rescue, Beyond the Code, After the Flood. Verify edition numbering through client metadata.
